newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: KL tin up three cents to 14.19 rgt/kg.
newsitem.headline: KL tin up three cents to 14.19 rgt/kg.

text.p: Malaysia's tin price rose three cents to 14.19 ringgit ($5.65) a kg, after tracking a slightly higher London Metal Exchange (LME), traders said.
The LME rose $5 on Tuesday and nudged up the domestic market, which was drifting without leads, said traders.
Buyers were from Europe and Malaysia, said traders
Initial bids totalled 110 tonnes against offers of 70. Turnover was 90 tonnes from 128 previously. The local premium against the LME was retained at $50.
